bahrain.title: Flag of the Kingdom of Bahrain
desc:
- The national flag of Bahrain (Arabic: علم البحرين‎) consists of a white band on the left, - separated from a red area on the right by five triangles that serve as a serrated line - The five white triangles symbolize the five pillars of Islam - Originally with 28 points, reduced to 8 in 1972, and to 5 in 2002 -

Tip: - It is sometimes mistaken for the flag of Qatar, but that flag is maroon, not red, - has more points (9) and normally has a much greater length-to-width ratio.
trivia:
- The wavy line has exactly 5 points, representing the five pillars of Islam
- The flag's ratio of 3:5 is less common than typical 2:3 or 3:5 ratios
- The serrated edge is said to symbolise the connection between Bahrain and Qatar historically
